fetch_review.claim: [CORE, anchors_claim=hook] In The Calamity episode 3, aired 2026-08-08, Hitsugaya, Kenpachi and Byakuya all attack Gerard Valkyrie and the episode ends with him mostly uninjured and the captains taking the damage instead.
fetch_review.note: Fetched fresh this session. Confirms episode number (3), title ('Blood for My Bone') and air date (August 8, 2026). On the outcome, exact quote: when the three captains injure his sword Hoffnung, 'they are the ones ending up with cuts.' Second, independent citation https://www.aol.com/articles/bleach-thousand-blood-war-calamity-173000000.html was also fetched fresh this session and confirms the same outcome in its own words: 'It only becomes worse when they are the ones getting hurt while he leaves the fight mostly uninjured.' Both sources independently describe the episode ending unresolved with all three captains still facing Gerard. Claim is doubly confirmed.

fetch_review.claim: [CORE, type D] Kenpachi Zaraki severs Gerard's hand and it regenerates immediately.
fetch_review.note: Fetched fresh this session. Exact quote: 'He severs Gerard's hand, which eventually grows back', described as a 'classic Kenpachi entrance.' Independently confirmed by the AOL recap fetched this session: 'cuts off Gerard's hand' and 'The hand grows back immediately, which shows how powerful Gerard's regenerative ability is.' IMPORTANT CORRECTION CAPTURED HERE: the task brief described this beat as Kenpachi severing Gerard's ARM. Both fetched anime sources say HAND, and the AOL recap explicitly flags the distinction ('specified as the hand rather than the arm'). The VO was written to say hand. This is the third factual error in this batch caught only by fetching -- see also the two logged in docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md F40.

fetch_review.claim: [CORE, type D] Toshiro Hitsugaya freezes Gerard's hand.
fetch_review.note: Fetched fresh this session. Exact quote: 'His hand freezes as we see the return of Toshiro Hitsugaya.' Independently confirmed by the AOL recap fetched this session: 'he freezes Gerard's hand' before the other captains engage. Doubly confirmed.

fetch_review.claim: [CORE, type D] Byakuya Kuchiki attacks with Senbonzakura Kageyoshi's cherry-blossom blade swarm.
fetch_review.note: Fetched fresh this session. States Byakuya enters using 'Senbonzakura Kageyoshi'. Independently confirmed by the AOL recap fetched this session, which describes him attacking 'with a swarm of cherry blossoms'. Doubly confirmed. NOTE ON A DELIBERATE OMISSION: the manga equivalent of this beat (chapter 671) has Byakuya use the Senkei form and its Ikka Senjinka secret technique. The FandomWire review explicitly does NOT specify whether the episode used Senkei or Ikka Senjinka, so the VO says only 'a swarm of cherry blossoms from Senbonzakura Kageyoshi' and does not name the sub-technique. Naming it would have been an inference from the manga, not a fetched fact about the episode.

fetch_review.claim: [CORE, type D] Gerard's The Miracle causes damage dealt to him and to his sword Hoffnung to land on the attacking captains instead.
fetch_review.note: Fetched fresh this session. Exact quote: the climax shows 'The Miracle' reversing damage -- when the three captains injure his sword Hoffnung, 'they are the ones ending up with cuts.' Independently confirmed by the AOL recap fetched this session: 'It only becomes worse when they are the ones getting hurt while he leaves the fight mostly uninjured.' Doubly confirmed. This is the package's central reveal and the beat the hook rests on.

fetch_review.claim: [CORE, type C] Episode 4 releases 2026-08-15 and is expected to carry the climax of the captains-versus-Gerard fight, which episode 3 leaves unresolved.
fetch_review.note: Episode 4's release date of Saturday, August 15, 2026 at 8:00am PDT (Hulu US / Disney+ global) is confirmed across the CBR release-date page and the FandomWire episode 4 guide, both surfaced this session, which also states the episode 'will likely see the climax of the battle between the captains and Gerard Valkyrie.' HEDGE DISCIPLINE (Law #149 point 3): the source hedges with 'likely', so the VO does NOT assert what episode 4 contains. The VO says only that the climax is 'held for episode four' -- i.e. that episode 3 ended unresolved, which is directly confirmed -- and makes no claim about episode 4's actual content.

verification_gaps_and_caveats.detail: Episode 3 aired 2026-08-08; post_date is 2026-08-15. verification_gaps_and_caveats.issue: Episode 4 airs the same day this package would post
verification_gaps_and_caveats.detail: Episode 4 releases 2026-08-15 at 8:00am PDT (11:00am ET). The proposed post times are 7:00pm ET (YouTube) / 7:15pm ET (TikTok), which is roughly eight hours AFTER episode 4 is already available. The package is factually accurate and within its window, but it is commentary on last week's episode published the evening the next one dropped. This is a genuine editorial weakness, not a rule violation, and it is Sebastian's call whether to send it, re-time it earlier, or rebuild against episode 4.

verification_gaps_and_caveats.issue: Manga verification performed this session but deliberately NOT used
verification_gaps_and_caveats.detail: Before the framing was settled, this session fetch-verified the manga equivalents of these beats: chapter 669 (Kenpachi severs Gerard's arm; regenerates stronger -- two independent fetches, though sources disagree on mechanism, shannaro.wordpress.com saying he 'rips Gerard's arm off with his mouth alone' while others say sliced), chapter 671 (Hitsugaya freezes Gerard, Gerard breaks free, Byakuya's Ikka Senjinka), and chapter 680 (Yhwach's Auswaehlen drains Gerard and Haschwalth -- confirmed by three independent fetches; Gerard 'is turned into a skeleton' confirmed by only ONE direct fetch quote, with two other fetches of the same chapter silent on it). NONE of this is used in the shipped package. Chapter 680 in particular is far ahead of the broadcast and would spoil the arc for an audience watching weekly. Recorded here so the verification work is preserved and auditable, and so no future session mistakes it for approved package content.

verification_gaps_and_caveats.issue: Spoiler warning is not mechanically enforced
verification_gaps_and_caveats.detail: cron_daily_runtime.txt requires a spoiler warning for EPISODE_MOMENT, but validate_dual_package.py contains no spoiler check and no EPISODE_MOMENT-specific logic at all (grep for 'spoiler' returns nothing). The warning is present in the VO as the second sentence ('Spoiler warning for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War, The Calamity, episode three, which aired August eighth') by authoring discipline, not because anything would have caught its absence. Worth a KNOWN_ISSUES entry as a validator gap.
